classification_contract.distinct_binding: Both exact Strategy IDs resolve and have different callable_family_id and binding_group_id values; this is not semantic independence.
classification_contract.distinct_binding_switch_share: distinct-binding transitions divided by total switches, defined only when total switches are nonzero and every switch is lineage-resolved.
classification_contract.exact_strategy_id_join: Case-sensitive equality against lineage.records[].strategy_id; no alias, prefix, display-name, or semantic matching.
classification_contract.hash_only_trace_rule: Without ordered endpoints, a nonzero switch count is resolved only when every unordered pair in the selected Strategy-ID support has one identical non-unresolved lineage class.
classification_contract.same_binding: Both exact Strategy IDs resolve and share one binding_group_id.
classification_contract.same_callable_different_binding: Both exact Strategy IDs resolve, share callable_family_id, and have different binding_group_id values.
classification_contract.unresolved_lineage: At least one exact Strategy ID is missing or source-unresolved, or the hash-only selector trace omits endpoints and selected-support pairs admit more than one possible class.
